items.title: Teardown: a B2B pitch that closed in one meeting
items.creator: Lena Ortiz
items.why: You pitch to Northwind on Thursday. This walks through a real first-meeting pitch, slide by slide, by the creator whose pricing video you liked.
summary: Open with their problem in their words, not your company history
One slide of proof (a number, a logo, a quote) beats five of features
End on a specific next step with a date, never 'let us know'

items.title: Why your best customers churn first
items.creator: Field Notes on SaaS
items.why: Retention is your Q4 goal, and this argues the at-risk accounts are the power users, with a simple way to spot them.
summary: Heavy users hit your product's limits first, so they leave first
Watch for a drop in breadth (features used), not just logins
A 15-minute call with three power users finds most of the gaps

items.why: You said you want to stop working past 22:00. This episode is about tiny, fixed shutdown routines rather than willpower.
summary: A fixed 'shutdown phrase' tells your brain work is over
Write tomorrow's first task before closing the laptop
